summary: Analyze advanced AKS cost efficiency. WHEN: \"AKS NAP readiness\", \"AKS bin packing\", \"AKS node scaling bottleneck\", \"AKS blocked scale-down\", \"AKS storage cost\".
whenToUse: DO NOT USE AS DIRECT ENTRY FOR: overall AKS cost assessments or rightsizing/VPA/CAS/Spot (azure-kubernetes); spend/anomalies/commitments (cost-analysis/cost-optimization); incidents (aks-troubleshooting).
Use for advanced existing-cluster analysis requiring scheduling, placement, or verified storage mapping.
Route overall AKS cost assessments to azure-kubernetes, spend/anomalies to cost-analysis, commitments to cost-optimization, and incidents to aks-troubleshooting when those skills are available.
verification: For default pools with CAS disabled: For custom pools, add --node-provisioning-default-pools None to disable default-pool creation, then apply the approved NodePool and AKSNodeClass manifests.
Verify pending-pod time, provisioned configurations, node count, workload SLOs, and cost against the agreed criteria.
